# ConsumableStock schemas
{: .no_toc}

Type-specific details of a lab's own stock of a consumable.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## How to use this family

- [`consumablestock`](/api/modules/consumablestock/): set `type` to a type code below and send its properties in `details`.
- Every version is published at `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/ConsumableStock/<Type>/<version>.json` and never changes; `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/ConsumableStock/<Type>.json` is the current version and `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/ConsumableStock/<Type>/` lists the versions. See [Public schemas](/api/public-schemas/).
- Quantities are objects `{"value": <number>, "unit": "<code>"}`. Property paths with `[]` are inside a repeatable list of rows. The server sets the schema version field itself.

## Reagents and Solutions

### Biological material

- type code `BiologicalMaterial` · version 1.0.0 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/ConsumableStock/BiologicalMaterial/1.0.0.json)

Vials or a lot of cells, a cell line, primary cells, organoids or tissue held in the lab, bought or banked from your own culture. Choose it for the material a culture or injection is started from; virus preparations are Virus solutions.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `batchId` | Batch ID | text |  |  | Supplier lot number from the certificate, or the lab's own bank identifier for a freeze-down. |
| `unitCount` | Vials or units in the lot | integer |  | ≥ 0 | Number of vials or units as received or as banked, not the number left today. |
| `cellsPerUnit` | Viable cells per vial or unit (as received or banked) | integer |  | ≥ 0 | Viable cells per vial or unit as counted on the lot certificate, or as frozen per unit at a lab freeze-down. |
| `viability` | Viability | quantity with unit |  | units `% of cells`; default `{"unit": "% of cells"}` | Viable cells as a percentage of all cells counted, from the lot certificate or counted at the freeze-down. |
| `passageAtFreeze` | Passage at freeze | integer |  | ≥ 0 | Passage number of the cells when this lot was frozen, as declared by the supplier or counted at the freeze-down. |
| `cryopreservationMedium` | Cryopreservation medium | text |  |  | Medium the cells of this lot are frozen in, as a named product or the lab's own mix. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "batchId": "text",
    "unitCount": 1
}
```

- `consumable` accepts Consumable types: [`BiologicalMaterial`](/api/schemas/consumable/#biological-material); other values are refused (400).

### Chemical reagent

- type code `ChemicalReagent` · version 3.0.2 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/ConsumableStock/ChemicalReagent/3.0.2.json)

A container or lot of a laboratory chemical held in the lab, as bought or made up as a stock solution. Solutions tissue is kept in are Physiological solutions, and fixatives and processing reagents are Histology reagents, even when made from these chemicals.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `batchId` | Batch ID | text |  |  | A unique identifier for the batch or lot number. |
| `compoundName` | Compound Name | text |  |  | Name of the chemical (e.g., 'Triton X-100', 'Paraformaldehyde'). |
| `chemicalType` | Chemical Type | choice | yes | one of `detergent`, `enzyme`, `indicator_ph_adjuster`, `salt_buffer`, `solvent`, `stain_dye`, `other` | General laboratory chemicals. Tissue-processing reagents belong to the Histology reagent type. |
| `molecularWeight` | Molecular Weight | quantity with unit |  | units `g/mol`, `kDa`, `Da`; default `{"unit": "g/mol"}` | Molecular weight of the chemical compound. |
| `amount` | Amount | text |  |  | Amount of the agent (e.g., '500 mL', '2 gram', '50 tablets'). |
| `concentration` | Concentration / Strength | text |  |  | If supplied in solution (e.g., '4%', '1 M', '10X'). |
| `purity` | Purity / Grade | text |  |  | E.g., '≥99%', 'Analytical grade', 'ACS reagent'. |
| `hazardInfo` | Hazard Information | text (multi-line) |  |  | Optional summary of safety hazards or GHS classification. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "chemicalType": "detergent",
    "batchId": "text",
    "compoundName": "text"
}
```

- `consumable` accepts Consumable types: [`ChemicalReagent`](/api/schemas/consumable/#chemical-reagent); other values are refused (400).

### Histology reagent

- type code `HistologyReagent` · version 1.1.2 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/ConsumableStock/HistologyReagent/1.1.2.json)

A lot of fixative, clearing agent, embedding or mounting medium, bought or made up in the lab. Keep each freshly prepared batch as its own stock, since the age and pH of a fixative change the result.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `batchId` | Batch ID | text |  |  | A unique identifier for the reagent batch or lot number. |
| `amount` | Amount | text |  |  | Amount held in this lot. |
| `concentration` | Concentration | text |  |  | Concentration of this lot, when it differs from the catalog product. |
| `pH` | pH | number |  | ≥ 0 and ≤ 14 | Measured pH of this lot. |
| `preparationDate` | Preparation Date | text |  |  | When this lot was made up. Fixatives and retrieval buffers are commonly prepared fresh. |
| `preparationInstructions` | Preparation Instructions | text (multi-line) |  |  | How this lot was prepared, including any dilution from a stock solution. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "batchId": "text",
    "amount": "text"
}
```

- `consumable` accepts Consumable types: [`HistologyReagent`](/api/schemas/consumable/#histology-reagent); other values are refused (400).

### Antibody or immunoreagent

- type code `ImmunoReagent` · version 2.0.4 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/ConsumableStock/ImmunoReagent/2.0.4.json)

A vial or lot of an antibody or other binding reagent held in the lab, pointing at its catalog entry. Keep each lot as its own stock: staining quality and the working dilution often differ between lots of the same antibody.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `batchId` | Batch ID | text |  |  | A unique identifier for the material batch or lot number. |
| `reagentType` | Reagent Type | choice | yes | one of `primary_antibody`, `secondary_antibody`, `fluorescent_label`, `dna_counterstain`, `other` | General classification of the reagent. |
| `hostSpecies` | Host Species | text |  |  | Host in which the antibody was raised (e.g., 'Rabbit', 'Mouse'). |
| `reactivity` | Reactivity Species | text |  |  | Species the antibody is reactive against (e.g., 'Rat', 'Mouse', 'Human'). |
| `targetAntigen` | Target Antigen | text |  |  | What the reagent binds to (e.g., 'GFAP', 'c-Fos', 'NeuN'). |
| `clonality` | Clonality | choice |  | one of `monoclonal`, `polyclonal`, `recombinant`, `unknown` | Whether the antibody is monoclonal or polyclonal. |
| `conjugate` | Conjugated Fluorophore or Enzyme | text |  |  | E.g., 'Alexa Fluor 488', 'HRP', 'None'. |
| `amount` | Amount | text |  |  | Amount of the agent (e.g., '500 mL', '2 gram', '50 tablets'). |
| `dilution` | Dilution | text |  |  | Dilution (e.g., '1:500', '2 µg/mL'). |
| `application` | Validated Applications | multi-select |  | one of `ihc`, `icc`, `western_blot`, `flow_cytometry`, `immunoprecipitation`, `other`; format select2 | Supported or validated experimental applications. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "reagentType": "primary_antibody",
    "batchId": "text",
    "hostSpecies": "text"
}
```

- `consumable` accepts Consumable types: [`ImmunoReagent`](/api/schemas/consumable/#antibody-or-immunoreagent); other values are refused (400).

### Pharmacological agent

- type code `PharmacologicalAgent` · version 3.0.4 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/ConsumableStock/PharmacologicalAgent/3.0.4.json)

A vial or lot of a drug held in the lab, as bought or diluted to a working stock. Keep a diluted working stock separate from the vial it came from: its concentration differs, and controlled drugs are tracked per container.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `batchId` | Batch ID | text |  |  | A unique identifier for the material batch or lot number. |
| `activeIngredient` | Active Ingredient | text |  |  | Primary pharmacologically active substance (e.g., 'Ketamine', 'Buprenorphine','Isoflurane'). |
| `amount` | Amount | text |  |  | Amount of the agent (e.g., '500 mL', '2 gram', '50 tablets'). |
| `concentration` | Concentration | text |  |  | Stated strength of the active ingredient (e.g., '10 mg/mL', '0.1%', '50 µg/tablet'). |
| `dosageForm` | Dosage Form | choice |  | one of `solution`, `suspension`, `tablet`, `capsule`, `injection`, `topical`, `patch`, `other` | Physical form in which the drug is supplied. |
| `routeOfAdministration` | Route of Administration | choice |  | one of `ip`, `iv`, `sc`, `oral`, `topical`, `inhalation`, `intracerebral`, `other` | Typical method of administration in experiments. |
| `pharmacologicalCategory` | Pharmacological Category | choice | yes | one of `analgesic`, `anesthetic`, `antibiotic`, `neuroactive`, `recreational`, `vehicle`, `experimental`, `other` | Broad category of action or use. |
| `pharmacologicalClass` | Pharmacological Class | text |  |  | Mechanistic or therapeutic class (e.g., 'NSAID', 'GABA agonist', 'NMDA antagonist'). |
| `formulation` | Formulation | text |  |  | List of excipients, solvents, or carriers (e.g., 'in 10% DMSO + saline'). |
| `purity` | Purity / Grade | text |  |  | E.g., '≥98%', 'USP', 'Analytical grade'. |
| `experimentalUse` | Experimental Use Context | multi-select |  | one of `surgical`, `behavioral`, `electrophysiology`, `histology`, `imaging`, `other`; format select2 | Contexts in which this agent is typically used. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "pharmacologicalCategory": "analgesic",
    "batchId": "text",
    "activeIngredient": "text"
}
```

- `consumable` accepts Consumable types: [`PharmacologicalAgent`](/api/schemas/consumable/#pharmacological-agent); other values are refused (400).

### Physiological solution

- type code `PhysiologicalSolution` · version 2.0.4 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/ConsumableStock/PhysiologicalSolution/2.0.4.json)

A batch of saline, PBS, Ringer's, aCSF or another physiological solution, bought or mixed in the lab. Most are mixed in-house, so each batch is its own stock with the composition actually made.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `solutionName` | Solution Name | text |  |  | Descriptive name of the solution (e.g., 'PBS', 'Saline + Tween 80'). |
| `composition` | Composition | text (multi-line) |  |  | Full recipe or formula (e.g., '0.9% NaCl in H2O', 'aCSF with 10 mM HEPES'). |
| `amount` | Amount | text |  |  | Amount of the agent (e.g., '500 mL', '2 gram', '50 tablets'). |
| `pH` | Target pH value | number |  | ≥ 0 | Target pH value as numeric value (e.g., '7.4'). |
| `osmolality` | Osmolality | text |  |  | In mOsm/kg, if known (e.g., '300 mOsm'). |
| `preparationInstructions` | Preparation Instructions | text (multi-line) |  |  | Steps for preparing or dissolving the solution (e.g., buffer components, filter sterilization). |
| `sterile` | Sterile | yes/no |  |  | Was the solution prepared or delivered sterile? |
| `purpose` | Purpose / Use | multi-select |  | one of `vehicle`, `perfusion`, `fixation`, `dissection`, `buffering`, `storage`, `slice_preparation`, `other`; format select2 | What is the primary use case for this solution? |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "solutionName": "text",
    "composition": "text"
}
```

- `consumable` accepts Consumable types: [`PhysiologicalSolution`](/api/schemas/consumable/#physiological-solution); other values are refused (400).

### Tracer or dye

- type code `TracerDye` · version 3.0.4 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/ConsumableStock/TracerDye/3.0.4.json)

A vial or lot of a dye or tracer held in the lab, as bought or dissolved to a working solution. Keep a working solution separate from the powder or concentrate it was made from.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `batchId` | Batch ID | text |  |  | A unique identifier for the material batch or lot number. |
| `dyeType` | Type of Dye or Tracer | choice | yes | one of `fluorescent_tracer`, `lipophilic_dye`, `retrograde_tracer`, `anterograde_tracer`, `histological_dye`, `vital_stain`, `injection_marker`, `other` | Function or classification of the dye/tracer. |
| `fluorophore` | Fluorophore | text |  |  | Fluorophore or spectral tag used (e.g., 'Alexa Fluor 555', 'FITC'). |
| `routeOfApplication` | Route of Application | choice |  | one of `injection`, `perfusion`, `topical`, `incubation`, `other` | How the dye is typically applied. |
| `excitationPeak` | Excitation Peak | quantity with unit |  | units `nm`, `µm`, `mm`, `m`; default `{"unit": "nm"}` | Peak wavelength for excitation (e.g., 550 nm). |
| `emissionPeak` | Emission Peak | quantity with unit |  | units `nm`, `µm`, `mm`, `m`; default `{"unit": "nm"}` | Peak wavelength for emission (e.g., 665 nm). |
| `amount` | Amount | text |  |  | Amount of the agent (e.g., '500 mL', '2 gram'). |
| `solvent` | Solvent / Vehicle | text |  |  | Solvent used for preparation (e.g., 'DMSO', 'Saline', 'Ethanol'). |
| `preparationInstructions` | Preparation Instructions | text (multi-line) |  |  | Preparation or dilution steps before application. |
| `experimentalUse` | Experimental Use Context | multi-select |  | one of `circuit_tracing`, `histology`, `injection_visualization`, `vital_staining`, `other`; format select2 | Typical applications of this tracer or dye. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "dyeType": "fluorescent_tracer",
    "batchId": "text",
    "fluorophore": "text"
}
```

- `consumable` accepts Consumable types: [`TracerDye`](/api/schemas/consumable/#tracer-or-dye); other values are refused (400).

### Virus solution

- type code `VirusSolution` · version 1.2.2 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/ConsumableStock/VirusSolution/1.2.2.json)

An aliquoted preparation of a viral vector held in the freezer, from a vector core or made in the lab, pointing at its construct in the catalog. Keep each preparation separate, since the titer differs between batches of the same construct.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `batchId` | Batch ID | text |  |  | A unique identifier for the material batch or lot number. |
| `titer` | Titer of virus solution | quantity with unit |  | units `vg/mL`, `gc/mL`, `TU/mL`, `IU/mL`, `pfu/mL`, `FFU/mL`, `vp/mL`; default `{"unit": "vg/mL"}` | Lot titer as received or prepared for this stock entry. |
| `volume` | Available volume | quantity with unit |  | units `nL`, `µL`, `mL`, `L`; default `{"unit": "mL"}` | The volume of the virus solution. |
| `aliquotCount` | The number of aliquots | integer |  | ≥ 0 | The number of aliquots. |
| `aliquotVolume` | The volume per aliquot | quantity with unit |  | units `nL`, `µL`, `mL`, `L`; default `{"unit": "µL"}` | The volume of each aliquot. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "batchId": "text",
    "titer": {
        "value": 1,
        "unit": "vg/mL"
    }
}
```

- `consumable` accepts Consumable types: [`VirusConstruct`](/api/schemas/consumable/#virus-construct); other values are refused (400).

## Device-Linked Consumables

### Connector component

- type code `ConnectorComponent` · version 1.0.2 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/ConsumableStock/ConnectorComponent/1.0.2.json)

Connectors, interface boards, adapters or tethers held in the lab, bought or assembled in-house. Keep a hand-built batch as its own stock so an implant can be traced to the parts it was built with.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `batchId` | Batch ID | text |  |  | A unique identifier for the batch or lot number. |
| `quantity` | Quantity | integer |  | ≥ 0 | Number of items held in this lot. |
| `assembledBy` | Assembled By | text |  |  | Who built this lot, for hand-assembled cables and interface boards. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "batchId": "text",
    "quantity": 1
}
```

- `consumable` accepts Consumable types: [`ConnectorComponent`](/api/schemas/consumable/#connector-component); other values are refused (400).

### Consumable device

- type code `ConsumableDevice` · version 4.0.3 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/ConsumableStock/ConsumableDevice/4.0.3.json)

Devices dedicated to or used up on one subject held in the lab, such as headstages, microdrives or fiber-optic cannula assemblies, pointing at their catalog entry. Probes, arrays and fibers have their own stock types.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `productId` | Product ID | text |  |  | Supplier or catalog identifier (e.g., 'DORIC_MFC_2x200'). |
| `deviceClass` | Device Class | choice | yes | one of `headstage`, `headstage_adapter`, `miniscope_baseplate`, `microdrive`, `drive_mount`, `fiber_cannula_assembly`, `thermal_interface_board`, `custom_fixture`, `other` | Subject-mounted assemblies. Interconnect hardware belongs to the Connector component type. |
| `compatibleWith` | Compatible Systems | text |  |  | E.g., 'Neuropixels', 'Inscopix', 'Open Ephys', 'Doric'. |
| `dimensions` | Physical Dimensions | text |  |  | Key geometry (e.g., '1.25 mm ferrule, 5 mm length'). |
| `material` | Material | text |  |  | Main material (e.g., stainless steel, zirconia, PEEK, plastic). |
| `connectivity` | Connectivity | text |  |  | Connector/interface type (e.g., 'LC/PC', 'Omnetics', 'pin header'). |
| `experimentalUse` | Experimental Use Context | multi-select |  | one of `chronic_implantation`, `acute_recording`, `optogenetics`, `imaging`, `behavioral_interface`, `other`; format select2 | Intended or validated experimental uses. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "deviceClass": "headstage",
    "productId": "text",
    "compatibleWith": "text"
}
```

- `consumable` accepts Consumable types: [`ConsumableDevice`](/api/schemas/consumable/#consumable-device); other values are refused (400).

### ECoG array

- type code `EcogArray` · version 1.0.0 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/ConsumableStock/EcogArray/1.0.0.json)

ECoG arrays of one design held in the lab, each array identified so it can be traced from the shelf into a subject and back out if recovered. Arrays are durable: they can fail or need maintenance, but do not run out or expire.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `arrayIds` | Array IDs | text |  |  | The identifier of each array in this lot, so a specific array can be traced from the shelf into a subject and back. |
| `quantity` | Quantity of arrays | integer |  | ≥ 0 | The number of arrays in this lot. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "arrayIds": "text",
    "quantity": 1
```
